==English==

===Etymology===
Multiplication sense from the idea that something is repeated or added together a given number of times.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|tīmz|a=RP,Canada,US}}, {{IPA|en|/taɪmz/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-times.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/tɑemz/|a=AusE}}
* {{rfv-pron|en}} {{IPA|en|/tɜːmz/|a=Tasmanian}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪmz|s=1}}

===Noun===
{{head|en|noun form}}

# {{plural of|en|time}}
#:''It's been ten '''times''' more difficult than expected.''

{{en-noun|p}}

# The [[circumstance]]s of a certain time.
#: {{ux|en|Modern '''times''' are so very different from the past.}}
#: {{ux|en|The concept has existed since '''times''' unknown.}}
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=1976
|author=w:Jan Fontein; Wu Tang
|chapter=Eastern Han Tomb near Holingol, Inner Mongolia
|title=Han and T’ang Murals discovered in tombs in the People's Republic of China and copied by contemporary Chinese painters
|url=https://archive.org/details/hantangmurals0000unse/
|publisher=w:Museum of Fine Arts, Boston
|ISBN=0-87846-102-7
|LCCN=76-44478
|OCLC=2524628
|page=38
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/hantangmurals0000unse/page/38/
|column=2
|text=The city called Fan-yang in Eastern Han '''times''' can be identified with the present village of Ch’u-wang (Nei-huang County, Honan Province).}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-06-08|volume=407|issue=8839|page=52
|title=[http://www.economist.com/news/international/21579039-chinas-growing-empire-ports-abroad-mainly-about-trade-not-aggression-new-masters The new masters and commanders]
|passage=From the ground, Colombo’s port does not look like much. Those entering it are greeted by wire fences, walls dating back to colonial '''times''' and security posts. For mariners leaving the port after lonely nights on the high seas, the delights of the B52 Night Club and Stallion Pub lie a stumble away.}}
# A person's experiences or biography.
#: {{ux|en|The Life and '''Times''' of Rosie the Riveter.}}

#: {{ux|en|One '''times''' one is one.}}

===Verb===

# {{infl of|en|time||s-verb-form}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|informal|arithmetic}} To [[multiply]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1994|author=Harvey Mellar|title=Learning with artificial worlds: computer-based modelling in the curriculum
|passage=I've taken the calories and the amount of food . . . and it's 410 calories per portion '''timesed''' by 6 portions which {{SIC}} the answer was 2460 calories...}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1995|author=Mathematical Association|journal=The Australian mathematics teacher, Volumes 51-53
|passage=A student as junior as Year 4 informed me that he made a forward estimate of cheeses in 100 trials by ''''timesing''' both numbers by 10' {{...}}}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1998|title=Psychology of mathematics education, Volume 2
|passage=Alex: Yeah - if you're '''timesing''' that distance there by this height, it will disappear.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1998|author=W. M. Roth|title=Designing Communities|publisher=Kluwer Academic Publishers|page=31
|passage={{...}} when the denominator was '''timesed''' by three, the same had to be done to the numerator; and so on.}}
